name: ad/static-ad
description: One-message static ad: a headline or a product capture as the single focal element, an accent CTA pill, the brand mark in the top-left corner. Reflows for landscape, square and portrait display and feed slots.

headline.doc: The one message. Seven words at most, two to five is best.

cta.doc: The call to action, rendered as the accent pill (the 10%).

image.doc: Product capture under assets/ (pass the file with build --assets). When set it is the focal visual; without it the headline is.

imageFocus.doc: CSS object-position for the capture crop; captures read from the top-left by default.

imageZoom.doc: Crop zoom into the capture in portrait and square slots (1 = the capture fitted by cover); 1.2-1.6 keeps a capture's type legible at feed size. Landscape slots ignore it: their column already crops.

url.doc: Short domain shown beside the CTA, optional.
